name: to_mkldnn_backward
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::to_mkldnn_backward(Tensor grad, Tensor input) -> Tensor. All registered schemas: aten::to_mkldnn_backward(Tensor grad, Tensor input) -> Tensor. Original Gems pytest owns the full contract — overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation — and must not be narrowed to this signature; no test may be removed or its reference adapted to fit this representative overload. Semantics derived from the tests: converts grad back out of opaque oneDNN/MKLDNN form; for a dense strided grad whose dtype already equals input.dtype it returns grad itself (identity, same storage) without copying, otherwise it returns a fresh strided tensor cast to input.dtype that keeps grad's shape and device. Only input.dtype and input.layout are read — a strided input is required and input shape/device are irrelevant — while the opaque-grad branch additionally honors oneDNN dtype restrictions and materializes a strided CPU tensor, and rejects opaque input. Neither grad nor input is mutated. The identity/aliasing return, the opaque-grad materialization path and the raised errors are conditional behaviors described here in prose because this single-signature model cannot express them.
